### Summary

The change renames the reusable workflow to niway-dev/wachi-reviewer, pins it to v1.2.0, and switches the command to `/wachi review`. The workflow, the ADR amendment and the CI doc agree with each other, and the ADR amendment's anchor slug matches its heading. I have one suggestion. An exact tag can still be re-pushed, so the \"never moves\" claim in the workflow comment and the ADR amendment is too strong. A commit SHA would give the guarantee the ADR describes.
